title: Stir Fry with Sweet and Bhuna
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry made with sweet potatoes, bhuna curry paste, and some vegetables.

ingredients.name: stir fry (vegetables of your choice)
ingredients.notes: You can use any combination of your favorite stir fry vegetables.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced sweet potato and cook for about 5 minutes, until it starts to soften.
Add the sliced peach and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until it starts to caramelize.
Add the stir fry vegetables and cook until they are tender.
Add the bhuna curry paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the silky soy sauce and stir well to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
